data.name: The Complex Chapter 1: Who, What, Where?
data.detailed_description:
The landlord is hosting a lively apartment party—but you’re sick and sleep through it. When you wake, you discover that many of the people who attended have mysteriously vanished. To uncover the truth, you must explore every corner, interact with characters, and solve challenging puzzles that reveal crucial clues. But the deeper you dig, the more dangerous the mystery becomes—and the closer you get to a horrifying realisation.

  • Investigate the Apartment: Search rooms, objects, and hidden areas for clues left by the landlord.

  • Solve Challenging Puzzles: Unlock secrets, access new areas, and piece together the story through clever problem-solving.

  • Face a Boss Fight: Confront the force behind the disappearances in a tense, climactic encounter in one of the endings.

  • Interact with Characters: Talk to people to gain insights, uncover motives, and progress your investigation.

  • Five Unique Endings: Your choices and discoveries shape one of five distinct outcomes—your choices matter!! Explore these 5 endings and 3 main endings... can you get the secret one?

Dive into a tense, atmospheric horror experience where observation, deduction, and courage are your only tools against the unknown in this Puzzle-Horror experience!

data.short_description: Wake up in a trashed apartment and investigate mysterious disappearances. Solve challenging puzzles, interact with others, and confront the person behind it all. Your choices lead to one of five unique endings in this tense, atmospheric puzzle-horror game!
